title: PowerShell appearance
subtitle: A readable, modern PowerShell terminal for CLI agents — fully optional and fully reversible.
themeDesc: Two-line prompt with Python, Git, path, status and execution-time segments; Catppuccin-adjacent colors.
previewNote: The preview is static; the real result appears in PowerShell after applying.

persian.title: Connected Persian letters in PowerShell
persian.description: Run PowerShell inside RtlTerminal for connected Persian letters. This separate terminal host provides text shaping; a font or UTF-8 alone is insufficient. Right alignment is not required.
persian.requirements: Version 1.1.4 for 64-bit Windows 10 build 19041 or newer; SHA-256 verified download. Installation requires Windows administrator approval.
persian.confirm: Download the official RtlTerminal 1.1.4 installer and run it after SHA-256 verification. Approve the Windows administrator prompt. This installs a separate terminal host; your default terminal and PowerShell profile are unchanged.
persian.verify: After installing, open Rtl Terminal from Start and select PowerShell. Type the sample below and check that its letters join. Installation success does not verify visual rendering.
persian.undo: Remove it from Windows Settings → Installed apps → Rtl Terminal. The theme restore action below only removes the prompt customization.

fontSource: Source: official Nerd Fonts & Vazirmatn repositories — OFL 1.1 license
applyTheme: Apply theme to the PowerShell profile
applyWhat: What happens: your $PROFILE is backed up and a marked idempotent block is added; no duplicate lines are created.
applyFont: Set the selected Windows Terminal profile font
applyFontNote: Only the selected profile, with a backup and reversible.
undoNote: Only the VibeHub-owned block is removed; your other customizations stay untouched.
verifyHint: Open a test PowerShell and check the icons and Git/Python segments render correctly.

errors.noWinget: No winget — install Oh My Posh from ohmyposh.dev.
errors.ompExists: Oh My Posh is already installed.
errors.noNerdFont: No Nerd Font installed; icons will show as boxes without one.
errors.ideMayNotApply: IDE terminals are affected only if they load $PROFILE; this may not apply.
